diagram_previews.alt: Two intersecting circles with centres O1 and O2 on opposite sides of the vertical common chord PQ (red, length a). The dashed segment O1O2 of length b crosses PQ at a right angle; radius O1P is c (blue) and radius O2P is r (green).

A small circle with centre O1 inside part of a large circle with centre O2, both centres on the same side of the common chord PQ (red, length a). The dashed line from O2 through O1 meets PQ; O1O2 = b, radius O1P is c (blue) and radius O2P is r (green).
